preconditions.description: The input `name` must be a string.

postconditions.expression: name == '' and return_value == 'name must be at least one letter'
postconditions.description: If the input `name` is an empty string, the output is the error message `'name must be at least one letter'`.

postconditions.expression: name != '' and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in return_value) and all(isinstance(char, str) and len(char) == 1 for row in return_value for char in row)
postconditions.description: If the input `name` is non-empty, the output is a perfect square matrix (nested list) where each element is a single character from the name or a period (`.`).

postconditions.expression: name != '' and len(return_value) == len(return_value[0]) and len(return_value) == len(name) + (len(name) % 2 == 0 and 0 or 1)
postconditions.description: The matrix is square with side length equal to the ceiling of the square root of the name's length (i.e., `n = ceil(sqrt(len(name)))`).

postconditions.expression: name != '' and len(''.join(''.join(row) for row in return_value)) == len(name) + (n * n - len(name)) and all(c in name or c == '.' for c in ''.join(''.join(row) for row in return_value))
postconditions.description: The matrix contains all characters of `name` in row-major order, padded with periods (`.`) to fill the square, where `n` is the side length of the matrix.
